# ReactPing

> A free, open-source Slack app that DMs you when someone else reacts to your Slack message: who reacted, the emoji, a one-line preview, and a link back.

Slack lists reactions in its Activity tab, but its notification settings cover DMs, mentions, thread replies, and keywords, not reactions. ReactPing fills that gap.

- Free forever: no paid plan or ads. MIT licensed.
- Two permissions: user `reactions:read` and bot `chat:write`.
- Never stores message text.
- Each person adds it for themselves. Your own reactions don't notify you.
- Disconnect from ReactPing's Home tab in Slack.

## Docs

- [How it works](https://reactping.com/how-it-works): setup, what triggers a DM, and what it shows
- [Security](https://reactping.com/security): permissions and storage, with links to the code
- [Privacy](https://reactping.com/privacy): what's stored, for how long, and how to delete it
- [Add to Slack](https://reactping.com/connect)
